about.title: About the Apartment
about.text: Apartment Mamut 1850 is a modern studio apartment located in the very center of Kamnik, Slovenia. It offers a comfortable stay for two guests with beautiful mountain views and easy access to Velika Planina, Ljubljana, and the Kamnik-Savinja Alps. The apartment includes a fully equipped kitchen, free Wi-Fi, private parking, and a cozy sleeping area, making it ideal for couples, solo travelers, and short city or nature getaways.

location.title: Location
location.text: Located in the historic center of Kamnik, Apartment Mamut offers one of the best-positioned stays in the town. Guests are within walking distance of cafes, restaurants, and old town attractions. The apartment is also a perfect base for visiting Velika Planina, the Kamnik-Savinja Alps, and Ljubljana, which is only a short drive away.
